import { Component } from '@angular/core'; //import { Flights } from 'src/app/models/flights.interface'; import { FlightsService, Flights } from 'src/app/services/flights.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-flights', templateUrl: './flights.component.html', styleUrls: ['./flights.component.css'] }) export class FlightsComponent { flights: Flights[] = []; newFlight: Partial = {}; editedFlight: Flights | null = null; aircraftFilter: string = ''; constructor(private flightsService: FlightsService) { this.loadFlightsByAircraft(); } /*loadFlights() { this.flightsService.getFlights().subscribe(flights => { this.flights = flights; }); }*/ loadFlightsByAircraft() { if (!this.aircraftFilter.trim()) { alert('Please enter an aircraft code to filter.'); return; } this.flightsService.getFlights(this.aircraftFilter.trim()).subscribe(flights => { this.flights = flights; }); } addFlight() { if (!this.newFlight._flightCode || !this.newFlight.route || !this.newFlight.aircraft || !this.newFlight.duration || !this.newFlight.dataOra) { alert('Please fill all fields.'); return; } const flight: Flights = { _flightCode: this.newFlight._flightCode, route: this.newFlight.route, aircraft: this.newFlight.aircraft, duration: this.newFlight.duration, dataOra: new Date(this.newFlight.dataOra).toISOString() }; this.flightsService.addFlights(flight).subscribe(() => { this.loadFlightsByAircraft(); this.newFlight = {}; }); } editFlight(flight: Flights) { this.editedFlight = { ...flight }; } saveFlightChanges() { if (this.editedFlight) { const updatedFlight: Flights = { ...this.editedFlight, dataOra: new Date(this.editedFlight.dataOra).toISOString() }; this.flightsService.updateFlights(updatedFlight._flightCode, updatedFlight).subscribe(() => { this.loadFlightsByAircraft(); this.editedFlight = null; }); } } cancelEdit() { this.editedFlight = null; } deleteFlight(flightCode: string) { if (confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this flight?')) { this.flightsService.deleteFlights(flightCode).subscribe(() => { this.loadFlightsByAircraft(); }); } } }
